capabilities: Preview note layout on A4 pages before exporting to PDF
Adjust text size, page margins, and line spacing for export
Add page numbers and start H1/H2 sections on new pages
Keep themes, Style Settings, and CSS snippets in the exported PDF
extras: Desktop-only; requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or later. Preview uses A4 page size only.
intentEvidence: PDF Export Enhancer extends the existing export dialog with a customizable settings panel and an A4 PDF preview.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Export to PDF offers limited formatting control and no way to see how the note will be laid out on pages before exporting.
summary: PDF export enhancer that adds an A4 page preview and extra formatting controls (text size, margins, page numbers, page breaks) to Obsidian's export dialog.
